native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, each crease's angle set jointly by the mark and the crease before it (state carried forward).

Every crease gauged against all four wire birds' beaks at once, refolded tighter until all four agree, with the spiral/snail markings deliberately left misaligned so two different piles can't coincide.
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge (with its one small suitcase) down to a single dense coin-sized corner, discarding every sheet, scrap and failed reading.
core_technique: wyhash/xxHash-style block hash: four parallel 64-bit lanes of 128-bit multiply-with-hi^lo-fold over 64-byte blocks, rotate-and-merge, 16-byte and overlapping-tail folds, then a length-keyed multiply-xorshift avalanche finalizer.
